d: The luteinized granulosa and theca cells left after ovulation; it secretes progesterone for about 14 days unless hCG rescues it.
The mid-cycle burst of LH produced when sustained high estradiol switches the pituitary to positive feedback; ovulation follows about 36 hours later.
Follicle cells that use FSH-induced aromatase to convert theca-cell androgens into estradiol, and that make inhibin.
